notes.title: Discounts and Fun!
notes.content:
Holidays
Spring has begun, and with it come some nice discounts! Save 82% when you purchase Cantirium: God Slayer and Soundtrack!
Updates
The latest updates have added support for gamepad control, and the game is available in 9 different languages with full localization. Improved graphics and fixed bugs!
Story DLC
I'm currently working on my new metroidvania + dating sim game - Meowphoria. After its release, I plan, as promised in the game itself, to make a free story add-on for Cantirium! In the meantime, add Meowphoria to your wishlist! ;3

notes.title: Gamepad controls and improvements!
notes.content:
Version 1.4

 Added gamepad control (except menu)
 Added language change to any of the available ones (English, Russian, French, German, Spanish, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese, Turkish, Japanese)
 Redesigned graphics (player portraits, land sprites, Tentacle spawn location has become more visible)
 Player attack range has been increased


Fixed:

 Fixed a bug in which many players did not display text in dialogues
 Fixed a bug when the player’s card was not found, but was displayed for a split second
 Fixed non-working buttons in the menu when starting a level

notes.title: 1.3 NAME TRANSLATIONS AND NEW FEATURES
notes.content:
Added:

 Character name translations in all 9 languages (Russian, English, French, German, Spanish, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese, Turkish, Japanese)!
 Some sounds have been reworked!
 Added another opportunity to get a map - near the castle!
 Reworked Boss - Diviner God. Now he has double damage, as well as his attacks have become faster and more interesting.
 Added small arrows on locations showing the way to holy items, or to the entrance to the Holy Lands.
 Some empty locations now contain small platform sections that require the wall climbing skill.

Corrected:

 The "Carved in Heaven" theme song is now full and doesn't break.
 After talking to Mushroom, the next time you enter the location, you will see a light in her house, as well as smoke from a chimney.
 Removed the harsh sound when breaking pitchers or barrels of coins.
 Fixed incorrect display of the player on the map.
 Fixed incorrect map.
 After talking to the Gorgon, the next time she enters the location, she will not start talking to the player.
 Fixed a bug due to which the God of Destruction was immortal.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43686647/785aa08f974d84ee82287078364d5383f90a0b33.png

notes.title: 1.2 RETHINKING THE GAME!
notes.content:
Added:

 Now, in order to get to the Holy Lands, you will need to get not only 5 holy items, but also get your hands on the "Basic Magic Eraser", which will remove the "Magic Barrier". It can be found in the Orange Forest.
 Now to get into the Orange Forest, you need to increase your sword damage to break through the Orange Vine barriers.


Corrected:

 Lots of visual and other bugs.
 Now the God of Destruction will not be immortal.
 Now, when defeating the God of Prophecy, his musical theme stops.
 Now that you have defeated Kirs, you will be safe.
 Now, when choosing the "God Slayer" ending, you will not encounter a bug due to which the final dialogue does not appear.


Thank you for staying with us!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43686647/ba48f96dee66d2eb4c56b2e05e073f41d1ffc72d.png

notes.title: GREAT UPDATE!
notes.content:
Added:

 Display the player on the map. Now, if you have a map, it will show the approximate location of the player!
 Coyote jump. Now jumping has become more responsive, and overcoming obstacles will become even more fun!
 Plant indicator. Now you will know where the enemy will come from, because now there is a small bush at the place of his appearance!


Corrected:

 Changed the wrong prices at the merchant. Now everything is fair and without deceit!
 Now you can get the achievement - "Amazed". Previously, it was not issued due to an error.
 Removed a bug due to which it was possible to break the game by pressing Escape during a dialogue.
 The first locations have been slightly reworked and become easier and more enjoyable!
 Fixed sticky blocks on one of the initial locations.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43686647/17f73c0dbd064467a3517075775fe72979713bf4.png
INCREDIBLY COOL UPDATE!
Big update with bug fixes and new mechanics to improve your adventure! Have a good game! ;3
